# sq-34 — Claim degenerate delimited tables

The delimited profiler claims three shapes it now rejects as "not a delimited table": a header with no data row, a one-column file, and a file with a row of another width among its first two data rows. Each is described with its evidence (row counts, field counts, the ragged line). **Not in this slice:** new regions or dialects.
